identity.pid: positive exact integer DWORD; never bool/float
identity.in_any_job: true; preliminary worker observation, not exact-Job authority

proxy_binding_requested.same_process: strict boolean, independently proved through retained handle

controller_events.proxy_binding_verified: native exact PID/birth/parent/private-Job and branch proof before ACK
controller_events.proxy_identity_cleanup: phase, binding_established, identities by role with Job-confirmed exit, helper query-handle closure and verified flag

ack.cardinality: once after one verified binding request
ack.deadline: counts within original acquisition deadline; no reset

split: interpreter PID distinct, birth>=launcher birth, exact native parent launcher PID, retained stable handles and exact same private Job
no_split: same actual retained launcher handle/process proves both role identities; two role exits refer to one physical process; any extra child fails
branch: only verified split launcher/interpreter edge plus unchanged accepted optional exact system console helper; unexpected/unclassified process fails
legacy: generic child_started/child_exit retain non-proxy meanings; legacy proxy_started/proxy generic-child events rejected
listening_pid_authority: accepted proxy os.getpid() validated as retained interpreter identity; never replaced with launcher PID
cleanup: normal protocol needs both zero-exit role events and retained native proofs; final Job cleanup confirms each role key; abort cleanup proof does not turn phase failure into success
future_readiness: structural only, no native APIs/live proxy/ownership/acquisition/build; NOT AUTHORIZED / NOT EXECUTED
